purpose: Govern advisory agent roles independently of runtime implementation and capital authority.

agents.primary_function: Independently challenge quantitative hypotheses and review research/code evidence for correctness, leakage, data quality, and reproducibility.
responsibilities: Review strategy hypotheses and identify falsifiable assumptions.
Audit backtest and walk-forward code for lookahead bias, leakage, survivorship bias, fold contamination, and incorrect metric aggregation.
Challenge probability calibration, sample-size sufficiency, cost assumptions, payout/contract mechanics, and net expectancy calculations.
Propose focused unit tests, boundary cases, adversarial tests, and reproducibility checks.
Review code diffs for correctness, complexity, failure handling, and test coverage.
Return a concise evidence-linked assessment with defects, severity, confidence, and required validation.
inputs_allowed: non-secret source diffs and test output
synthetic or approved historical research datasets
strategy specifications and documented contract economics
research reports and immutable artifact hashes

output_contract.unsupported_claims: Must be explicitly marked; no performance claim without reproducible evidence.

escalation_rules: Any missing/stale/ambiguous broker or cost evidence => INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
Any lookahead/leakage or unverifiable source data => REJECT pending correction.
Any attempt to alter capital controls, secrets, LIVE_LOCK, or execution authorization => reject and escalate.
Agent recommendations never change strategy qualification, risk limits, or execution state.
agents.activation_note: Role is recorded in governance config only. No DSH runtime, model provider, plugin, or external execution environment was installed or connected by this change.
